estado: A escolhida, mapa ampliado em avaliação visual
prompt:
Create a PRODUCTION GAME MAP BACKGROUND image, landscape 3072x2048 or 3840x2560 high resolution if possible. Use attached as style reference ONLY option A (the upper 2D illustrated map). Paint ONE LARGE EXTENDED fully explored regional map with generous terrain space for 30 distinct playable regions. Output ONLY the seamless edge-to-edge map painting, absolutely NO text, labels, UI, header, buttons, border, fog of war, icons, markers, hexes, grid lines, territory boundaries, compass or symbols. NOT a concept sheet.
Art style very high quality HAND PAINTED 2D TOP-DOWN tropical cartography, crisp stylized individual small round canopies as in upper reference, richly detailed green vegetation, strong golden highlights, warm terracotta clearings and paths, turquoise rivers, Brazilian Atlantic forest. Palette deep forest green, rich canopy lime and yellowish highlights, blue green water, orange earth. Camera truly overhead flat illustrated map. NOT a tilted 3D diorama or photographic aerial.
Build a LARGE explorable fictional local landscape reminiscent of the Atlantic forest of coastal Bahia. Main broad winding river curves from upper middle near x.60,y.05 down to x.62,y.45, passes near x.52,y.65 then exits lower edge x.63,y1.0. Several smaller tributaries, waterfalls, western wooded hills and low rocky ridges, northern deep dense rainforest, southern clearings, eastern lowland with palms, marsh-free riverbanks. Optional a sliver of far eastern turquoise coastal water and sand, but most image is explorable land. Distinctive clearings, waterfalls, boulders, ridges, groves, stream bends and small lagoons throughout, with small footpaths connecting some near the village. The game will draw 30 clickable region labels over this entire image. Keep terrain scale consistent and fairly zoomed-out to make world feel expansive.
A single tiny native village with THREE TRIANGULAR GREEN LEAF ROOF huts around small orange campfire in clearing, centered precisely at x=38% of image width,y=62% height. Tiny village occupies only 4% width, roofs are elongated triangular green fronds, no straw round huts, no tipis, no stone buildings, no medieval architecture, no castles. Village on west side of main river and southwest of a close river bend. Dense lush vegetation fills remainder of image at consistent map scale. River can have tiny exposed rocks, no boats. NO other settlements, people, fauna, fantastic monsters or political borders. Imagery is fictitious landscape art for a game, with no claim to reproducing actual geography or indigenous maps. Make all regions equally polished and zoomable. Output map terrain only, absolutely NO fog or text.
nota: Região fictícia, 30 áreas são a proposta inicial. Prévia isolada, reconhecimento e salvamento da etapa 6 aguardam aceite visual.
